stopped_because: ran the 5 iterations it was given
policy_prompt_for_subgoal: Every episode starts at the first decision step with empty memory and the demonstration shown; the subgoal there is the first character of the plan string just built from the demonstration (position 0). At every decision step, the subgoal is the character at position moves_done (0-based) of the plan string, where moves_done is the value written at THIS step: 0 at the first step, carried value plus one at later steps). So the first step performs plan[0], the second step plan[1], and so on. No subgoal needs a point. After a move finishes, the next decision step always advances to the next plan letter regardless of where the gripper ended; never repeat or skip. If moves_done is at or beyond the length of the plan (nothing remains), repeat the last character of the plan string. If the plan could not be built (no demonstration visible and empty plan), derive the direction from the two highlighted targets currently visible if there are two (direction from the older-looking one near the gripper to the other, same dy/dx rule), otherwise choose A: move forward. In any other unforeseen situation, pick plan[moves_done] if it exists, else A.

fields.name: plan
fields.description: The ordered list of menu letters the demonstration traces. If this step shows DEMONSTRATION STEPS (the first step, memory empty), build it now and never change it afterwards: the highlighted target at demo t=0 is the start (this start marker may be labelled 'highlighted area' rather than 'highlighted target'; use its coordinates as the starting highlighted position for the first dy/dx computation); each time a different target becomes highlighted in the demo frames, take dy = new y minus previous highlighted y and dx = new x minus previous highlighted x (coordinates at the frame it first appears). |dy| >= 8 with dy > 0 means forward, dy < 0 means backward; |dx| >= 8 with dx > 0 means left, dx < 0 means right; both over threshold means the diagonal (forward=A, backward=B, left=C, right=D, forward-left=E, forward-right=F, backward-left=G, backward-right=H). One letter per newly highlighted target, in demo order. If the step shows no demonstration, copy the carried-in plan character for character. Write the value as one plain string of bare capital letters in order, with nothing else: no quotes of any kind, no brackets, no commas, no spaces. Position 0 is the first move. The value is compared character by character, so EDGH is right and ["E", "D", "G", "H"] or ['E', 'D', 'G', 'H'] are both wrong. e.g. EDGH

fields.name: moves_done
fields.description: How many planned moves have been finished by the scene at this step. Write 0 when the step shows demonstration steps and the carried memory is empty (first step). Otherwise the step shows execution steps of one completed move, so write the carried-in moves_done plus one. e.g. 2
